title: Prospective, placebo-controlled clinical trial with Aconite Pain Oil in oncological patients under-going chemotherapy to prevent chemotherapy-induced polyneuropathy (CIPN), to re-duce symptoms typical of CIPN and to improve the quality of life of patients with CIPN
official: Prospective, placebo-controlled clinical trial with Aconite Pain Oil in oncological patients undergoing chemotherapy to prevent chemotherapy-induced polyneuropathy (CIPN), to reduce symptoms typical of CIPN and to improve the quality of life of patients with CIPN
summary: Main objective: The risk of CIPN in the treatment period can be reduced by 35% by using verum as compared to placebo
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. A consent form, fully dated and signed by the patient and the principal investigator/investigator, is available
2. Patients with a minimum age of 18 years
3. Patients with a Karnofsky Index ≥ 70%
4. Patients with an assumed life expectancy of at least 12 months
5. Patients with solid tumours
6. Patients who are scheduled to receive unmodified chemotherapy with taxanes or platinum derivatives or their combination approved in Germany for at least 3 months (3 lunar months  / 12 weeks)
7. Patients of childbearing age must provide a negative pregnancy test
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participation in an interventional trial (with an investigational product) that is concurrent or occurred within 4 weeks prior to inclusion in this trial
2. Patients with previous or current neurotoxic medication outside the planned chemotherapy protocol that has an impact on the primary endpoint (at the investigator´s discretion) and prior taxane and/or platinum derivative administration
3. Patients with the following known comorbidities that predispose them to CIPN: inadequately substituted hypothyroidism, renal insufficiency grade 4 and above, vasculitis/collagenosis, inadequately treated diabetes mellitus
4. Patients with active and/or clinically relevant infectious diseases: HIV, Lyme disease, hepatitis B/C, herpes infections
5. Known presence of multiple myeloma or non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma
6. Present neurological diseases, Alzheimer’s disease, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson’s disease, and other neurological diseases that make it difficult or impossible to assess the primary endpoint according to the investigator’s opinion
7. Patients with metastases in the central nervous system
8. History of amputation of extremities
9. Patients with distal muscle weakness and/or atrophy
10. Skin lesions or other findings in the area of the extremities that make it impossible to use the investigational product (e.g., hand-foot syndrome)
11. Presence of any other serious acute or chronic organic or mental illness with severe impairment of the general condition that impairs or prevents regular participation in the trial
12. Pregnant and breastfeeding patients or patients who are not using effective contraception (Pearl index < 1)
13. Use of co-analgesics such as gabapentin, pregabalin, amitriptyline, nortriptyline, clomipramine, imipramine, duloxetine 1 week before commencement of the trial (baseline) and intake during the trial before reaching CIPN grade III
14. Planned acupuncture for the treatment of CIPN during the trial
15. Topical application of substances such as lidocaine, capsaicin, botulinum toxin, amitriptyline, menthol to hands and/or feet up to 1 week before trial entry (baseline) and application during the trial
16. Electrotherapy on the extremities up to 1 week before the start of the trial (baseline) and during the trial
17. Patients treated with topical and/or internally administered medicinal products or cosmetics containing aconite (Aconitum napellus), camphor (Camphora), lavender essential oil (Lavandulae aetheroleum), and/or quartz within 4 weeks prior to inclusion in this trial
18. Patients with known hypersensitivity to camphor and/or any of the other ingredients of Aconite Pain Oil, as well as peanut or soy
19. Patients who are not expected to be able to comprehend the significance of the clinical trial, to demonstrate the necessary compliance, and/or to complete the patient questionnaire and patient diary in the German-language for language-related, cognitive, or other reasons
20. Patients with a planned application of chemotherapy at ≥4-week intervals
21. Patients with alcohol/drug/medication dependency
22. Patients with known genetic predispositions to polyneuropathies
23. Patients with previous or current polyneuropathy irrespective of cause
